description: Warnings named: the collection day is further out than the load check looks, so Own fleet has no load check (OutsideHorizon), and no Carrier prices the Lane. Known answer: assign-own-fleet, naming that there is no load check for the day.

setup.seed: Book a Transport Order as Brouwer Dranken from Rotterdam to Paris, France (6 pallets, 1800 kg) collecting well beyond the Capacity view's horizon, and leave it unassigned. Set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to the Transport Order's number.

input: Suggest who should carry the Transport Order ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT}, with the reasoning and the trade-off against the other options.

explanation.rubric: Recommends Own fleet and says there is no load check for the collection day, as a warning it accepts.
